cohort: 100 pregnant participants, divided into two groups: those with hypertension and those without.
finding: Hypertension during pregnancy was associated with altered placental morphology (reduced weight, diameter, area, volume, and thickness) and lower fetal birth weight.
mod_finding: Lower section cesarean section rates were higher (45%) in the hypertensive group.
birth_weight: 2.82+/-0.43 kg in the control group and 2.33+/-0.84 kg in the hypertension group
